payload.outcome: Closed after PR #1965 landed on main (commit 3ec6116): scripts/check-playwright-browser-revision.mjs now always resolves an effective browsers root and verifies a real launchable executable exists for the pinned revision, closing the false-OK gap where the old check could report ok:true (managed-or-unconstrained) without touching the filesystem. New regression tests pin both the false-OK scenario and the directory-exists-but-binary-missing case.
